items.title: Pakistan opens crypto licensing portal, sets Sept. 5 deadline for existing firms
items.snippet: Existing virtual asset providers must apply for an NOC by Sept. 5 or cease operations under Pakistan’s new regulatory framework.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо загального ринку -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.

items.title: Ray Dalio says investors should own ‘a bit of Bitcoin’ as U.S. debt risks rise
items.snippet: The Bridgewater founder says recent Treasury-market stress fits his long-running debt-crisis framework, though he still prefers gold as the bigger hedge.

items.title: Stablecoin neobank Fasset lands $1 billion valuation as SBI backs its payments push
items.snippet: The firm raised $68 million as its revenue has grown six-fold as stablecoin payments and settlement expand, CEO Mohammad Raafi Hossain told CoinDesk.

items.title: Crypto holds big weekly rally as Warsh’s Jackson Hole debut comes into focus
items.snippet: Bitcoin holds above $77,000 after a 21% week, with XRP up 46% over the same stretch. Asian stocks fell as Samsung and Alibaba slid.
items.note: Позитивний тон для BTC, XRP за ключовими словами.

items.title: Term Finance loses estimated $8.5M in vault governance exploit
items.snippet: Term permanently closed its Meta Vaults after an attack reportedly removed nearly all of their Ethereum deposits.
